component.name: Messages
component.summary: Chat over Signal, Matrix, and WhatsApp

description.p: Read and send messages through supported Signal, Matrix, and WhatsApp accounts. Manage conversations, attach files, and receive desktop notifications.
Messages is available on enzim Apps for Signal, Matrix, and WhatsApp accounts.
On first launch, the sample conversations are clearly marked and you can go straight to account setup.
Add Flatpak packaging for enzim Apps.
